orc.description: Strong frontline and fast ranged attacks.

dwarf.description: Armored infantry, fortress defenses and siege. Slow to take ground.

elf.description: Mobile archers, forest ambush and healing. Fragile in a prolonged fight.

undead.description: Cheap skeletons and corpse magic. Weak defenses and slower gathering.

heavy.name: Shield Wall
heavy.description: Reduce incoming damage by 30% for 5 seconds.

vanguard.name: Stoneheart Aura
vanguard.description: +3 armor for allies nearby for 6 seconds.

pathfinder.name: Siege Command
pathfinder.description: Nearby siege cannons gain +12 building damage for 7 seconds.

support.name: Mend
support.description: Restore up to 25 HP to each of three wounded allies.

pathfinder.name: Moonshot
pathfinder.description: +5 attack damage and +24 range for 6 seconds.

vanguard.name: Windstride
vanguard.description: Nearby troops move 20% faster for 5 seconds.

support.name: Raise the Fallen
support.description: Raise one nearby corpse into a temporary skeleton.

pathfinder.name: Grave Chill
pathfinder.description: Strike up to three visible enemies with frost.

vanguard.name: Grave Might
vanguard.description: +5 damage for 5 seconds. Kills restore 18 HP.
